title: Implementation Science
html: Swanson and colleagues should be commended for their insightful perspective in their September JADA article titled “Driving Emerging Technology to Clinical Impact (Swanson WB, Wu DT, Yoshida M, et al. JADA. 2026;157[9]957-967. doi:10.1016/j.adaj.2026.01.021), which addresses one of the most persistent challenges in dental innovation: translating promising scientific advances into meaningful improvements in patient care. Their proposed right-to-left translational paradigm offers a timely framework that shifts the emphasis from regulatory approval alone to the generation of clinically relevant evidence, early stakeholder engagement, and the ultimate goal of successful clinical adoption.
